The '''Haluria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Vendusii sector/Legends|Vendusii sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] regions.<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the creatures known as [[Halurian ice-boar]]s.<ref name="PoD" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Haluria system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-16.<ref name="TEA" />
